title: Diversity-Oriented Synthesis and Antibiofilm Evaluation of Furan-2-Carboxamides.
authors: Munoz-Estrada, Ana C; Tovar-Roman, Cesar E; Garcia-Mejia, Carlos D; Garcia-Contreras, Rodolfo; Hernandez-Vazquez, Eduardo
one_liner_zh: 该文研究呋喃甲酰胺类化合物的抗菌膜活性及与LasR蛋白的分子对接，属于小分子-蛋白互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: A diversity-oriented collection of furan-2-carboxamides with antibiofilm activity against P. aeruginosa is reported. The design involved the bioisosteric replacement of the labile furanone ring by a furan-2-carboxamide moiety to explore its influence on biological activity. After evaluation, carbohydrazides and triazoles showed significant antibiofilm activity, and 4b resulted in the most remarkable compound (58 % inhibition). Furthermore, treating P. aeruginosa with three active carboxamides reduced some virulence factors (pyocyanin and proteases), confirming the anti-quorum sensing properties of the derivatives and suggesting LasR as a plausible target. Molecular docking proposed that carbohydrazides share a similar binding mode to related furanones inside LasR with an excellent docking score, while higher derivatives diminished in silico affinity.
abstract_zh: 报道了一个针对铜绿假单胞菌具有抗生物膜活性的呋喃-2-甲酰胺类多样性导向化合物库。设计涉及将不稳定的呋喃酮环通过生物电子等排替换为呋喃-2-甲酰胺部分，以探索其对生物活性的影响。评估后，碳酰肼和三唑类化合物显示出显著的抗生物膜活性，其中4b是最突出的化合物（抑制率58%）。此外，用三种活性甲酰胺处理铜绿假单胞菌减少了某些毒力因子（绿脓菌素和蛋白酶），证实了这些衍生物的抗群体感应特性，并提示LasR为可能的靶点。分子对接提出，碳酰肼在LasR内部与相关呋喃酮共享相似的结合模式，且具有优异的对接评分，而更高阶的衍生物在硅片上的亲和力则有所降低。
